lessons.prompt: Create a commit and print `setup` in the log.
lessons.reference_solution:
git init
git config user.email padawan@example.local
git config user.name Padawan
echo setup > app.txt
git add app.txt
git commit -m setup
git log --oneline

lessons.hidden_hint: Make the smallest change that satisfies the prompt.
lessons.reference_solution:

git config user.email padawan@example.local
git config user.name Padawan
echo base > app.txt

echo work >> app.txt
git stash push -m work
echo stash saved
